title: peltostigma guatemalense
intro: Peltostigma guatemalense, commonly known as Guatemalan kino tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Peltostigma guatemalense include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
